registryPackageReason: The published @moq/net@0.3.5 has gitHead c3e9cc6c1ca8f030505b5f83ec2bf39843972f89 and lacks Draft 21.

localPatches.purpose: Bound and encode the standard Draft 21 Authorization Token SETUP option.
Place the opaque authorization proof in the outgoing SETUP.
Expose authorization connect props, validate before dialing, and require moqt-21 without WebSocket fallback.
Expose retained-frame accounting and eviction hooks used by bounded track caches.
Enforce optional local hard group/frame bounds for producer and subscriber caches.
Accept local track cache limits when creating a static broadcast track.
Coalesce the field-by-field writes an encoder issues in one task into a single WebTransport write (one QUIC STREAM frame per object instead of ~6 tiny packets).
New: Draft 21 OBJECT_DATAGRAM (section 11.2.1) codec; emits single-object groups (END_OF_GROUP|ZERO_OBJECT_ID|DEFAULT_PRIORITY), drops malformed/status datagrams instead of closing the session.
Forward a subscribed track's datagrams as OBJECT_DATAGRAMs (Group ID = datagram sequence), best-effort, never awaited.
Route received OBJECT_DATAGRAMs by track alias to the subscription's track as datagrams.
Run the OBJECT_DATAGRAM receive loop for the session (best-effort, never fatal).
Synchronous alias lookup for datagram routing.
